{{Recipe}}

This recipe for '''hazelnut meringue''' can be used to make smaller meringue [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookies]] or larger discs to serve as the base of another [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] such as a [[Cookbook:Pavlova|pavlova]].

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 1 lb (500 g) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
* 1 lb (500 g) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|confectioners' sugar]]
* 1 lb (500 g) skinned [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnuts]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

== Preparation ==

# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites to soft peaks.
# Gradually beat in the caster sugar, little by little, and continue whipping to form stiff peaks.
# Fold in the confectioners' sugar and nuts, working carefully to avoid deflating the egg whites.
# Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]]. With a pencil, draw circles of the desired diameter using a plate or [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tin]].
# Using a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|pastry bag]] with a ½-inch plain round tip, [[Cookbook:Piping|pipe]] a spiral, starting at the centre of the circles, working outward toward the edge forming a disc about ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 250°F (120°C) until crisp and very lightly browned, 1½ to 2 hours.
